import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'

def write_project(name, source):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
        [package]
        name="{name}"
        version="0.1.0"

        [[target.bin]]
        name="{name}"
        path="src/main.fzy"
    '''))
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
    return root

def compile_project(name, source, strict=False):
    root = write_project(name, source)
    cmd = [str(fz), 'build', str(root), '--json']
    if strict:
        cmd.append('--strict')
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    return root, proc.returncode, payload

def verify_project(name, source, strict=False):
    root = write_project(name, source)
    cmd = [str(fz), 'verify', str(root), '--json']
    if strict:
        cmd.append('--strict')
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    return root, proc.returncode, payload

def find(items, needle):
    return next(item for item in items if needle in item['message'])

artifact_root, artifact_rc, artifact_payload = compile_project('rpc_hardening_artifacts', '''
    rpc Ping(req: i32) -> i32;
    rpc Pong(req: str) -> i32;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        timeout(50)
        Ping(1)
        Pong("ok")
        cancel()
        return 0
    }
''')
assert artifact_rc == 0 and artifact_payload['status'] == 'ok', (artifact_rc, artifact_payload)
rpc_report = json.loads((artifact_root / '.fz' / 'rpc-safety.json').read_text())
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['deadlinePerCall'] is True, rpc_report
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['handlerCancelCleanup'] == 'required', rpc_report
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['requestOwnershipExplicit'] is True, rpc_report
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['responseOwnershipExplicit'] is True, rpc_report
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['payloadTypesSupported'] is True, rpc_report
assert rpc_report['strictRequirements']['methodNameStable'] is True, rpc_report
payload_contracts = {item['method']: item for item in rpc_report['payload_contracts']}
assert payload_contracts['Ping']['requestOwnershipExplicit'] is True, payload_contracts
assert payload_contracts['Ping']['responseOwnershipExplicit'] is True, payload_contracts
assert payload_contracts['Ping']['payloadTypesSupported'] is True, payload_contracts
assert payload_contracts['Ping']['errorNormalization'] == 'status_code', payload_contracts
cancel_policies = {item['method']: item for item in rpc_report['cancel_policies']}
assert cancel_policies['Ping']['cleanupPolicy'] == 'missing', cancel_policies
assert cancel_policies['Pong']['cleanupPolicy'] == 'explicit', cancel_policies
assert cancel_policies['Pong']['handlerCleanupStatus'] == 'explicit', cancel_policies
deadline_policies = {item['method']: item for item in rpc_report['deadline_policies']}
assert deadline_policies['Ping']['policy'] == 'explicit', deadline_policies
assert deadline_policies['Pong']['policy'] == 'missing', deadline_policies

cleanup_root, cleanup_rc, cleanup_payload = verify_project('rpc_strict_cleanup', '''
    rpc Ping(req: i32) -> i32;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        timeout(25)
        Ping(1)
        return 0
    }
''', strict=True)
assert cleanup_rc == 1, (cleanup_rc, cleanup_payload)
cleanup_diag = find(cleanup_payload['items'], 'without an explicit recv()/cancel() cleanup policy')
assert 'Handle every RPC call with `recv()` or `cancel()`' in (cleanup_diag.get('help') or ''), cleanup_diag

deadline_root, deadline_rc, deadline_payload = verify_project('rpc_strict_deadline', '''
    rpc Ping(req: i32) -> i32;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        recv()
        Ping(1)
        return 0
    }
''', strict=True)
assert deadline_rc == 1, (deadline_rc, deadline_payload)
deadline_diag = find(deadline_payload['items'], 'without an explicit timeout/deadline on every call path')
assert 'Add `timeout(...)` or `deadline(...)`' in (deadline_diag.get('help') or ''), deadline_diag

borrowed_root, borrowed_rc, borrowed_payload = verify_project('rpc_borrowed_payload', '''
    rpc Ping(req: &str) -> i32;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        return 0
    }
''')
assert borrowed_rc == 1, (borrowed_rc, borrowed_payload)
borrowed_diag = find(borrowed_payload['items'], 'parameter `req` uses unsupported payload type `&str`')
assert 'RPC payloads must cross the boundary as owned/value data' in (borrowed_diag.get('help') or ''), borrowed_diag

trace_source = write_project('rpc_trace_order', '''
    use core.thread;
    rpc Ping(req: i32) -> i32;
    rpc Pong(req: i32) -> i32;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        Ping(0)
        Pong(0)
        timeout(10)
        cancel()
        return 0
    }
''')
trace_path = trace_source / 'rpc.trace.fozzy'
run_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'test', str(trace_source), '--det', '--record', str(trace_path), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
run_payload = json.loads(run_proc.stdout.strip())
assert run_proc.returncode == 0, (run_proc.returncode, run_payload, run_proc.stderr)
assert run_payload['status'] == 'pass', run_payload
stem = trace_path.stem
native_trace = trace_path.parent / f'{stem}.native.trace.json'
native_payload = json.loads(native_trace.read_text())
frame_events = [frame['event'] for frame in native_payload['rpcFrames']]
assert frame_events == ['rpc_send', 'rpc_send', 'rpc_deadline', 'rpc_cancel'], frame_events
print('compiler-rpc-hardening-ok')
